To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the socialization process of youth in transnational spaces is a complex one.

1) Ghanaian youth who live their life transnationally are faced with challenges in their sexual identity construction; 2) Ghanaian youth living in the Netherlands are exposed to different forms of sexual education, which are different from what they have received in Ghana; 3) Ghanaian youth are faced with different sexual education programmes in Ghana and the Netherlands; 4) The Ghanaian parents in the Netherlands are not happy with the sexual education their children are exposed to in the Netherlands;
the social and cultural contexts of young people in the Netherlands and Ghana are very different, but that the young people are influenced by the social and cultural context in both countries.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how transnational spaces and places influence the construction of sexual identities of young people of Ghanaian descent in the Netherlands and how these spaces and places influence young people in constructing their sexualities.
how the sexual socialization process of Ghanaian youth living in the Netherlands is shaped and influenced by their transnational experiences.
the social and cultural construction of sexuality and the role of transnationalism in this construction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
transnationalism is an important concept in understanding the sexualities of young people.

the sexual socialization that young people experience at the national level in Ghana and in the Netherlands are often in contestation with each other, thus, the sexual socialization and construction of sexual identities of migrant youth is a complex process.
the social construction of sexualities is a complex process and the social construction of sexuality is not just a local or national phenomenon, but it is transnational in nature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transnationalism has a strong impact on how people construct their sexual identities and the way they live them.
the study shows how the socialization of young people is influenced by the different social and cultural contexts that they find themselves in.

, young people's sexualities are constructed across transnational spaces and the construction of sexualities is influenced by the different social, cultural and religious values of the places they inhabit.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the sexual identities of young people with transnational background are not only shaped by their experiences in their destination country, but also by the cultural, legal and religious discourses of their countries of origin and the countries they reside in.

the sexual socialization and construction of sexualities among young Ghanaian migrants in the Netherlands are shaped by their experiences and exposure to the Dutch education system, the Ghanaian culture and their religious beliefs.
transnationalism is a useful framework in studying sexual identities.
